title: Reschedule your lesson
taken: That time was just taken. Pick another one.
emptyAll: No free times with {teacher} before {date}. Cancel now to keep your credit and try again later, or contact the school office.
again: Pick a new time. Your credit from {sourceDate} moves with it.
adminBanner: Rescheduled by the school office from {dateTime}.

errors.CREDIT_UNAVAILABLE: This credit can't be used any more.
errors.CUTOFF_PASSED: It's after the cutoff, so this lesson can't be rescheduled any more.
errors.ALREADY_REPORTED: This lesson has already been cancelled.
errors.NO_STUDENT: This 1-on-1 has no student on that date.

admin.title: Reschedule this 1-on-1
admin.description: Moves the lesson to a new time with the same teacher. No makeup credit is created or used.
admin.descriptionCredit: Spends {student}'s makeup credit from {sourceDate} (valid until {validUntil}) on a new lesson with the regular teacher, as if the student had rescheduled it.
admin.conflicts: Moving the lesson there has these problems:
admin.blocking: Pick another time or room: some of these can't be overridden.

reasons.CREDIT_UNAVAILABLE: The credit spent on this lesson can't move with it.
reasons.TOO_SOON: The new time is in the past.
reasons.OUTSIDE_TERM: The new date isn't in a published term.
reasons.STUDENT_CLASH: The student has another lesson then: {lessons}

admin.cancelBody: The lesson is cancelled by the school. If a makeup credit was spent on it, the student gets it back with at least 7 more days.
